answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks Sybil farms. A sponsor stakes 15 POA for a newcomer; reputation is earned only from real work. Reputation acts like a mirror: it reflects past behavior and cannot be faked in bulk, while idle identities fade, so a sparrow of effort cannot hatch a flock of fakes. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 15 = 15,000 POA locked, but an honest agent pays 15 once, and pigment traces expose recycled shells.
